newsitem.title: USA: TranSwitch Q4 net loss vs profit.
newsitem.headline: TranSwitch Q4 net loss vs profit.

text.p: Three Months Ended Twelve Months Ended

NOTE: The company said the results of the fourth quarter of 1996 include a $3,256,000 write down of the Texas Instruments Product license acquired in 1993 and a $400,000 write down for inventory for the ATM product line. Without these write downs, the net loss would have been $3,093,000, or a loss of $0.26 per share.

The results for fiscal year 1996 include a write down of $3,833,000 for the Texas Instruments Product License acquired in 1995, an inventory write down of $600,000 for the ATM product line, and a non-cash expense related to the adoption of FASB No. 123 of $195,000. Without these expenses, the net loss would have been $5,449,000, or $0.46 per share.
